data.title: Absolute Security Acquires Phoenix Technologies’ FirmGuard to Build on the Firmware Foundation Enterprises Need for Secure, Compliant, and Resilient AI
data.description: A company based in Seattle, Absolute Security, known for its expertise in Autonomous Cyber Resilience, revealed that it has successfully completed the acquisition of Phoenix Technologies’ FirmGuard. The latter specializes in UEFI BIOS firmware security, along with management and networking services. This acquisition will bring new capabilities to Absolute Security's existing technology, known as Absolute Persistence®, which is a patented firmware-embedded solution forming the core of their Autonomous Cyber Resilience Platform. With the addition of FirmGuard, the platform will now offer enhanced features such as increased visibility, integrity verification, posture management, continuous patching, as well as compliance enforcement for endpoints and AI workstations.

data.title: SpaceX's Mobile Plans Trigger Towering Gains For These Stocks
data.description: On Friday, the stocks of cell tower operators surged as investors anticipated increased business opportunities due to SpaceX's wireless service. The positive news drove significant gains for these companies, with shares seeing a notable increase in value. This development has sparked optimism among shareholders and market analysts alike, speculating on potential growth and revenue prospects for the tower operators in light of SpaceX's mobile plans.

data.title: Cisco Appoints Girish Rishi to its Board of Directors
data.description: Cisco has added Girish Rishi to its board of directors, a move set to take effect on October 9, 2026. data.title: Ryder Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
data.description: In Miami, the Board of Directors of Ryder System, Inc. announced a regular quarterly cash dividend of $1.01 per share of common stock. The dividend will be paid on December 18, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 23, 2026. This marks the company's 201st consecutive quarterly cash dividend, demonstrating 50 years of consistent dividend payments. Ryder System, Inc. (NYSE: R) is a major player in the outsourced logistics and transportation services sector, with a market value of nearly $13 billion.
